model.description: Vendor-defined model identifier. The valid set is publisher-defined and MAY be advertised via Homie `$format` on the property.

firmware-version.description: Firmware version. Published when the device has firmware; a bare or surveyed device (e.g., a dumb load center) omits it.

data-model-version.description: Version of the eBus data model this device publishes (e.g., `"1.0"`).
